headlines.title: ADP (ADP) Stock Retreats As Q1 Results Meet A Premium Valuation
headlines.summary: Automatic Data Processing walked into this earnings day with a rich 25x trailing P/E and a one month gain of about 9%, then saw the stock slip about 2.6% to US$285.37 as investors reacted to fresh numbers. Q1 FY2027 did not read like a disappointment, with revenue of US$5,490.7m and basic earnings per share of US$2.84, but expectations were high after a strong run.

headlines.title: Why Is Automatic Data Processing (ADP) Expanding Its Small Business Payroll Reach?
headlines.summary: Automatic Data Processing (NasdaqGS:ADP) and PNC Bank announced a new integrated payroll and HR solution for small businesses. The partnership embeds ADP payroll and HR tools directly into PNC’s digital banking platform for business clients. Small enterprises using PNC’s online banking are expected to access payroll, HR and cash management functions within a single interface.

headlines.title: What Automatic Data Processing (ADP) Said on Its Q1 Earnings Call
headlines.summary: Automatic Data Processing (NASDAQ:ADP) reported fiscal first-quarter results that exceeded its expectations, citing revenue growth, margin expansion, higher adjusted earnings per share and continued demand across its payroll, human-capital-management and compliance offerings.

headlines.summary: Moby summary of Automatic Data Processing, Inc.

description: Automatic Data Processing, Inc. provides cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions worldwide. It operates in two segments, Employer Services and Professional Employer Organization (PEO). The Employer Services segment offers strategic, cloud-based platforms, and human resources (HR) outsourcing solutions. This segment's offerings include RUN Powered by ADP, a software platform for small business payroll, HR, and compliance; ADP Workforce Now, a HCM solution used across mid-sized and large businesses to manage employees; and ADP Lyric HCM, a solution for HR management, payroll, workforce management, talent, and data analytics. Its PEO Services segment provides HR outsourcing solutions under ADP TotalSource name to businesses through a co-employment model. This segment also provides guidance, user-friendly technology, comprehensive employee benefits, and a risk management, safety, and workers' compensation program. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Roseland, New Jersey.
